name: Telangana Rythu Bharosa Scheme (Farmers & Agricultural Labourers)
shortDescription: Annual direct investment support of ₹15,000 per acre to landowning farmers and ₹12,000 per year to landless agricultural labourers in Telangana.
fullDescription: The Government of Telangana implemented the Rythu Bharosa scheme as a flagship agricultural transformation guarantee. It offers ₹15,000 per acre per year (₹7,500 each for Kharif and Rabi crop seasons) to all eligible farmers holding patta passbooks or RoFR forest title deeds. Additionally, it extends ₹12,000 per year to verified landless agricultural families to ensure financial resilience and eliminate agrarian distress.
department: Department of Agriculture and Cooperation, Government of Telangana
benefitDetails: ₹15,00,000 financial security net across seasons: ₹15,000 per acre per year for farmers (paid in two seasonal installments of ₹7,500 each); ₹12,000 per year for landless agricultural labourers via direct bank transfer (DBT).
eligibilitySummary: Resident farmer owning agricultural land in Telangana with updated Dharani / Bhumatha patta title or RoFR patta; or landless agricultural labourer household with valid Food Security Card.

rules.conditionName: Agricultural Land or Farm Labourer Status

documents.name: Pattadar Passbook / Dharani Title
documents.description: Digitally verified Dharani portal Patta passbook or RoFR record.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Aadhaar linked to bank account for NPCI direct benefit transfer.

applicationSteps.title: Land Record Verification on Dharani
applicationSteps.description: Ensure agricultural land parcel is properly mapped and Aadhaar-seeded in Dharani / Bhumatha records.

applicationSteps.title: Enrollment via Agriculture Extension Officer
applicationSteps.description: AEO conducts field verification of the cultivator or farm labourer during Gram Sabha / Praja Palana drives.

applicationSteps.title: DBT Fund Disbursement
applicationSteps.description: Assistance is credited directly into the bank account linked via Aadhaar Payment Bridge before each cropping season.

name: Telangana Mahalakshmi Scheme (Free TSRTC Bus Travel for Women)
shortDescription: 100% free bus travel for all domicile women, girls, and transgender persons across Telangana in TGS-RTC buses.
fullDescription: Launched under the Six Guarantees, the Mahalakshmi Free Bus Travel Scheme provides unrestricted free travel to girls, women of all ages, and transgender persons resident in Telangana on State-owned public transport corporation buses (Palle Velugu, Express, City Ordinary, and Metro Express within the state borders).
department: Transport Department & TSRTC (TGS-RTC), Government of Telangana
benefitDetails: Zero-fare tickets issued across Palle Velugu, Express, and City buses within Telangana state boundaries.
eligibilitySummary: Girls and women of all ages and transgender persons domiciled in Telangana. Must produce valid government photo ID card proving Telangana domicile upon boarding.

documents.name: Telangana Domicile Photo ID
documents.description: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or Resident Certificate with Telangana address.
documents.issuingAuthority: Govt of India / Govt of Telangana

applicationSteps.title: Board Eligible Bus
applicationSteps.description: Board any TSRTC (TGS-RTC) Palle Velugu, Express, or City Ordinary/Metro bus within Telangana.

applicationSteps.title: Present ID to Conductor
applicationSteps.description: Show Aadhaar card or valid government ID with Telangana residence address.

applicationSteps.title: Receive Zero-Fare Ticket
applicationSteps.description: Conductor issues an instant zero-fare Mahalakshmi paper ticket for the intended destination.

name: Telangana Mahalakshmi Scheme (LPG Cylinder Refill at ₹500)
shortDescription: Domestic LPG cylinder refills at a subsidized rate of ₹500 for eligible BPL families in Telangana.
fullDescription: Under the Mahalakshmi Guarantee, the Telangana Government provides domestic LPG cooking gas cylinders to Food Security Card (White Ration Card) holder families at an effective cost of ₹500 per cylinder. Consumers pay the cylinder price at delivery, and the excess amount above ₹500 is directly credited by the State Government into the beneficiary woman's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
department: Civil Supplies Department, Government of Telangana
benefitDetails: Direct bank transfer (DBT) subsidy covering the entire retail difference above ₹500 per cylinder refill for up to eligible quota per year.
eligibilitySummary: Telangana resident holding an active White Ration Card (Food Security Card) with active domestic LPG connection in the name of the woman of the family.

rules.sourceClause: G.O.Ms.No.9 Consumer Affairs, Food & Civil Supplies

documents.name: Food Security Card (White Ration Card)
documents.description: Active FSC card copy with beneficiary woman name.
documents.issuingAuthority: Civil Supplies Dept, Govt of Telangana

documents.name: LPG Consumer Connection Passbook
documents.description: Domestic gas connection booklet or subscription receipt.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Beneficiary woman Aadhaar linked to bank account.

applicationSteps.title: Submit Praja Palana Application
applicationSteps.description: Submit Praja Palana form or apply online linking Food Security Card and LPG Consumer ID.

applicationSteps.title: Book Gas Cylinder
applicationSteps.description: Book LPG refill through regular distributor channels and pay standard delivery price.

applicationSteps.title: Receive Balance Refund via DBT
applicationSteps.description: State government automatically credits the subsidy amount (bill amount minus ₹500) into the Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

name: Telangana Gruha Jyothi Scheme (200 Units Free Electricity)
shortDescription: Free domestic electricity up to 200 units per month for all eligible residential households in Telangana.
fullDescription: Telangana Gruha Jyothi scheme fulfills the promise of providing up to 200 units of free power per month to residential consumers possessing Food Security Cards (White Ration Cards). The scheme exempts households from energy charges, customer charges, and electricity duties for consumption up to 200 kWh per billing cycle.
department: Energy Department, TGSPDCL & TGNPDCL, Government of Telangana
benefitDetails: Zero electricity bill for consumption up to 200 units per month for domestic connections.
eligibilitySummary: Resident domestic electricity consumer in Telangana with active Food Security Card (White Ration Card), unique Service Connection Number linked to Aadhaar.

documents.name: Domestic Electricity Bill / USC No
documents.description: Recent electricity bill showing domestic Category-I service connection.

documents.description: Active White Ration Card registered in Telangana.

documents.description: Aadhaar of consumer matching ration card records.

applicationSteps.title: Submit Application via Praja Palana / MeeSeva
applicationSteps.description: Provide Consumer USC Number, White Ration Card number, and Aadhaar on Praja Palana or DISCOM portal.

applicationSteps.title: Database Linking and Verification
applicationSteps.description: DISCOM links service meter to Civil Supplies ration card registry.

applicationSteps.title: Issuance of Zero Electricity Bill
applicationSteps.description: Meter reader issues a monthly zero bill showing full subsidy for units consumed under 200 units.

name: Telangana Indiramma Indlu Housing Scheme
shortDescription: Financial assistance of ₹5,00,000 for constructing a permanent house for homeless poor and plot owners in Telangana.
fullDescription: The Indiramma Indlu Scheme provides housing assistance of ₹5,00,000 to economically disadvantaged homeless families in Telangana. For families who already own a residential plot of land, ₹5 lakh is provided in four construction milestone stages. For shelterless families without land, a residential house site plot along with ₹5 lakh financial assistance is sanctioned.
department: Telangana State Housing Corporation Limited (TSHCL), Government of Telangana
benefitDetails: ₹5,00,000 financial grant released in 4 stages (Basement, Roof Level, Roof Slab, and Completion) + MGNREGS wage component and SBM toilet assistance.
eligibilitySummary: Homeless families or those residing in katcha huts in Telangana holding a White Ration Card; priority given to SC, ST, minority, and female-headed households.

documents.name: Plot Title Deed / Possession Certificate
documents.description: Registered document, Gram Panchayat / Municipal patta, or possession certificate.

documents.name: White Food Security Card
documents.description: Proof of BPL status in Telangana.

documents.name: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Account Passbook
documents.description: Bank account details of the woman head of household for stage-wise DBT.

applicationSteps.title: Application through Praja Palana or Gram Sabha
applicationSteps.description: Apply during Praja Palana ward/village assemblies or via MeeSeva.

applicationSteps.title: Field Verification & Geotagging
applicationSteps.description: Housing engineer conducts physical inspection and geotags the plot location.

applicationSteps.title: Sanction Order & Stage-Wise Fund Release
applicationSteps.description: District Collector sanctions approval; funds disbursed at basement, roof level, slab, and completion.

name: Telangana Dalit Bandhu Scheme
shortDescription: Direct financial grant of ₹10,00,000 per eligible Scheduled Caste (SC) family for enterprise creation with 100% subsidy.
fullDescription: Telangana Dalit Bandhu is an economic empowerment initiative offering ₹10,00,000 direct one-time grant to eligible SC families to start businesses, trade, manufacturing, or service enterprises. The assistance is a 100% direct grant with no bank linkage, collateral, or repayment requirement, designed to foster Dalit entrepreneurship and financial autonomy.
department: Scheduled Castes Development Department, Government of Telangana
benefitDetails: ₹10,00,000 direct financial grant credited into dedicated Dalit Bandhu bank account for starting approved enterprise or business activity.
eligibilitySummary: Permanent resident of Telangana belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) community with valid caste certificate and Food Security Card.

documents.name: Integrated Caste Certificate (MeeSeva)
documents.description: Valid SC community certificate issued by Revenue Department.

documents.name: Food Security Card
documents.description: White ration card confirming family composition.

documents.name: Business / Enterprise Profile
documents.description: Detailed business idea or asset selection statement.

applicationSteps.title: Identification and Verification by District Committee
applicationSteps.description: District Collectorate and SC Corporation identify beneficiaries in assembly constituencies.

applicationSteps.title: Selection of Business Sector
applicationSteps.description: Beneficiary chooses enterprise (agriculture, transport, retail, manufacturing, services) with guidance.

applicationSteps.title: Account Opening & Fund Disbursal
applicationSteps.description: Special Dalit Bandhu bank account opened and ₹10 lakh deposited directly for asset creation.

name: Telangana Kalyana Lakshmi / Shaadi Mubarak Scheme
shortDescription: One-time financial assistance of ₹1,00,116 for the marriage of brides from SC, ST, BC, EBC, and Minority families in Telangana.
fullDescription: Kalyana Lakshmi (for SC, ST, BC, and EBC brides) and Shaadi Mubarak (for Minority brides) provide one-time financial aid of ₹1,00,116 directly deposited into the unmarried bride's mother's or bride's bank account before marriage, preventing child marriage and alleviating financial stress on poor families.
department: Scheduled Castes, ST, BC & Minority Welfare Departments, Government of Telangana
benefitDetails: ₹1,00,116 one-time direct bank transfer for marriage expenses.
eligibilitySummary: Unmarried girl resident in Telangana aged 18 years or above; annual family income not exceeding ₹2,00,000 (urban) or ₹1,50,000 (rural); belonging to SC, ST, BC, EBC, or Minority communities.

documents.name: Bride Age Proof / SSC Certificate
documents.description: SSC marks memo or Birth Certificate issued by competent authority.

documents.name: Income Certificate from MeeSeva
documents.description: Income certificate issued within last 6 months.

documents.name: Wedding Invitation Card (Lagna Patrika)
documents.description: Wedding invitation or certificate from religious authority / Jamaat.

applicationSteps.description: Upload bride and groom details, MeeSeva certificates, and wedding date.

applicationSteps.title: Field Verification by Mandal Revenue Officer (MRO)
applicationSteps.description: Revenue Inspector and Tahsildar physically verify age, eligibility, and marriage details.

applicationSteps.title: Sanction and Direct Bank Credit
applicationSteps.description: Amount of ₹1,00,116 is credited directly into the bride's/mother's bank account.

name: Telangana ePASS Post-Matric Scholarship (Reimbursement of Tuition Fee - RTF)
shortDescription: 100% or sanctioned tuition fee reimbursement for eligible SC, ST, BC, EBC, and Minority college students in Telangana.
fullDescription: Telangana ePASS RTF pays college tuition fees directly to colleges on behalf of eligible post-matric students (Intermediate, ITI, Polytechnic, Degree, Engineering, Medicine, MBA, MCA, and Ph.D.). Admitted under the convenor quota through standard entrance tests (TG EAPCET, ICET, ECET, etc.), the program ensures zero out-of-pocket tuition expense for disadvantaged communities.
department: BC Welfare & SC Development Departments, Government of Telangana
benefitDetails: Full sanctioned tuition fee reimbursed directly to the educational institution as notified by the Telangana Admission and Fee Regulatory Committee (TAFRC).
eligibilitySummary: Telangana domicile student enrolled in recognized post-matric course under convenor quota with family income <= ₹2,00,000 (SC/ST/Rural BC) or ₹1,50,000 (Urban BC/EBC) and minimum 75% attendance.

documents.name: Latest Income Certificate
documents.description: MeeSeva income certificate issued in the current financial year.

documents.name: CET Allotment Order
documents.description: Convenor quota admission order with hall ticket number.

applicationSteps.title: Register on ePASS Portal
applicationSteps.description: Submit fresh/renewal post-matric scholarship application on telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in.

applicationSteps.title: College Principal Verification
applicationSteps.description: College verification officer confirms bonafide admission, certificates, and biometrics.

applicationSteps.title: District Welfare Officer (DWO) Sanction
applicationSteps.description: DWO verifies and approves fee disbursement directly to the college treasury account.

name: Telangana ePASS Post-Matric Maintenance Fee & Mess Charges (MTF)
shortDescription: Monthly hostel and maintenance stipend of up to ₹1,400 per month for SC, ST, BC, and Minority college students in Telangana.
fullDescription: Telangana ePASS MTF (Maintenance Fee) provides monthly living allowances and mess charges to eligible post-matric college students. Disbursed quarterly, it supports College Attached Hostels (CAH), Department Attached Hostels (DAH), and Day Scholars with fixed monthly stipends deposited directly into students' bank accounts.
department: BC Welfare & SC Development Departments, Government of Telangana
benefitDetails: Up to ₹1,400 per month for hostellers (CAH/DSWH) and ₹650 per month for day scholars, disbursed on a quarterly basis.
eligibilitySummary: Students eligible for Telangana ePASS RTF residing in attached hostels or attending as day scholars with regular 75% biometric attendance.

documents.name: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Passbook
documents.description: Bank account copy of student with IFSC and NPCI mapping.

documents.name: Hostel Stay Certificate / Bonafide
documents.description: Warden/Principal certificate confirming hostel stay or day-scholar status.

applicationSteps.title: Select MTF in ePASS Application
applicationSteps.description: Check MTF hostel option while submitting ePASS Post-Matric registration.

applicationSteps.title: Biometric Attendance Authentication
applicationSteps.description: Authenticate via Aadhaar-enabled biometric attendance system (AEBAS) in college.

applicationSteps.title: Quarterly DBT Transfer
applicationSteps.description: Welfare department credits maintenance stipend into student's Aadhaar-linked bank account.

name: Telangana Rajiv Aarogyasri Health Scheme
shortDescription: Cashless hospitalization healthcare cover up to ₹10,00,000 per family per year in empaneled network hospitals across Telangana.
fullDescription: Rajiv Aarogyasri is Telangana's premier universal health assurance scheme providing comprehensive cashless inpatient care up to ₹10,00,000 per family per year. Covering over 1,672 medical and surgical procedures across heart disease, cancer, nephrology, neurosurgery, orthopedics, and polytrauma, it ensures end-to-end cashless treatment including diagnostics, medicines, implants, and post-discharge follow-ups.
department: Aarogyasri Health Care Trust, Department of Health, Medical and Family Welfare, Govt of Telangana
benefitDetails: Cashless in-patient treatment up to ₹10,00,000 per family per year across 1,672 secondary and tertiary medical therapies in empaneled hospitals.
eligibilitySummary: Resident families in Telangana holding valid Food Security Card (White Ration Card) or Rajiv Aarogyasri Card.

documents.name: White Food Security Card / Aarogyasri Card
documents.description: Ration card or Aarogyasri health card with family member names.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card of Patient

applicationSteps.title: Approach Aarogya Mithra Desk
applicationSteps.description: Aarogya Mithra verifies Food Security Card and Aadhaar, registers patient, and initiates pre-authorization.

applicationSteps.title: Avail Cashless Treatment & Discharge
applicationSteps.description: Hospital delivers cashless surgery/treatment, free diagnostic tests, medicines, and food.

name: Andhra Pradesh Talliki Vandanam Scheme (Amma Vodi)
shortDescription: Annual financial aid of ₹15,000 per school-going child directly credited to the mother's bank account in Andhra Pradesh.
fullDescription: Talliki Vandanam (the enhanced iteration of the Amma Vodi scheme under Andhra Pradesh's Super Six guarantees) supports education from Class 1 to 12. It provides ₹15,000 annually per school-going child directly into the mother's bank account, ensuring that poverty never prevents a parent from educating their children.
department: Department of School Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefitDetails: ₹15,000 per year per school-going child directly credited into the mother's or guardian's Aadhaar-enabled bank account.
eligibilitySummary: Mother or legal guardian of children studying in Class 1 to 12 in recognized schools/junior colleges in AP; family holding Rice Card with student attendance >= 75%.

documents.name: AP Rice Card / BPL Proof
documents.description: Valid Rice Card issued by Civil Supplies Dept AP.

documents.name: Mother & Child Aadhaar Cards
documents.description: Aadhaar cards linked to student ChildInfo / U-DISE ID.

documents.name: Mother's NPCI-Mapped Bank Passbook
documents.description: Active bank account linked with Aadhaar.

applicationSteps.title: Gram/Ward Sachivalayam Social Audit
applicationSteps.description: Village/Ward Education Secretary displays beneficiary lists for social audit and biometric eKYC.

applicationSteps.title: Annual DBT Transfer
applicationSteps.description: Funds are credited directly to the mother's bank account.

name: Andhra Pradesh Annadata Sukhibhava Scheme (Rythu Bharosa)
shortDescription: Annual input financial assistance of ₹20,000 per farmer family per year in Andhra Pradesh.
fullDescription: Annadata Sukhibhava provides ₹20,000 annual income support to farmer families in Andhra Pradesh (combining the Central PM-KISAN ₹6,000 and the State Government contribution of ₹14,000). The assistance is disbursed in three seasonal installments to landowning farmers, tenant farmers holding Crop Cultivator Rights Cards (CCRC), and forest land cultivators under RoFR.
department: Department of Agriculture & Cooperation, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefitDetails: ₹20,000 per year per farmer family disbursed in three installments (Kharif sowing, Rabi sowing, and harvest/Sankranti).
eligibilitySummary: Farmer families cultivating agricultural land in Andhra Pradesh with registered land records, tenant farmers with CCRC cards, or RoFR forest title holders.

applicationSteps.title: Direct Benefit Transfer
applicationSteps.description: Seasonal installments are deposited directly into the farmer's bank account.

name: Andhra Pradesh Jagananna Vidya Deevena (RTF - Full Fee Reimbursement)
shortDescription: 100% full tuition fee reimbursement for college and professional students from low-income families in Andhra Pradesh.
fullDescription: Jagananna Vidya Deevena ensures complete higher education access by providing 100% college tuition fee reimbursement for students pursuing Polytechnic, ITI, Degree, Engineering, Medicine, Pharmacy, MBA, and MCA courses. The sanctioned tuition fee is credited on a quarterly basis directly into the mother's bank account to promote financial oversight.
department: Department of Higher Education & Social Welfare, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefitDetails: 100% college tuition fee reimbursement as determined by the AP Higher Education Regulatory and Monitoring Commission (APHERMC).
eligibilitySummary: Resident of Andhra Pradesh; annual family income <= ₹2.5 Lakhs; landholding <= 10 wet acres or 25 dry acres; no four-wheeler; minimum 75% attendance.

applicationSteps.title: Sachivalayam Verification & eKYC
applicationSteps.description: Welfare and Education Assistant verifies family eligibility parameters and completes biometric eKYC.

applicationSteps.title: Quarterly Fee Credit
applicationSteps.description: Tuition fees released into mother's account, which is then paid to the college.

name: Andhra Pradesh Jagananna Vasathi Deevena (MTF - Hostel & Boarding Aid)
shortDescription: Annual food and hostel maintenance allowance up to ₹20,000 for college students in Andhra Pradesh.
fullDescription: Jagananna Vasathi Deevena assists college students from economically vulnerable backgrounds with boarding, food, and accommodation costs. It sanctions ₹10,000/year for ITI students, ₹15,000/year for Polytechnic students, and ₹20,000/year for Degree, Engineering, and PG students, credited in two installments into the mother's bank account.
department: Department of Higher Education & Social Welfare, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefitDetails: ₹10,000/yr for ITI, ₹15,000/yr for Polytechnic, and ₹20,000/yr for Degree/PG students in two installments.
eligibilitySummary: Same criteria as Vidya Deevena: AP domicile, family income <= ₹2.5 Lakhs, enrolled in recognized post-matric course with >= 75% attendance.

documents.name: Mother's Bank Account Passbook
documents.description: Active bank passbook linked to Aadhaar.

applicationSteps.description: Integrated automatically when submitting Jnanabhumi Vidya Deevena application.

applicationSteps.title: Sachivalayam Social Audit
applicationSteps.description: Local Sachivalayam checks attendance and approves eligibility.

applicationSteps.title: Direct Account Credit
applicationSteps.description: Funds released directly to the mother's account in two equal installments.

name: Andhra Pradesh Dr. YSR Aarogyasri Health Scheme
shortDescription: Cashless hospitalization healthcare cover up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year covering 3,257 procedures in Andhra Pradesh.
fullDescription: Dr. YSR Aarogyasri is Andhra Pradesh's flagship healthcare program providing cashless medical treatment up to ₹25,00,000 per eligible family per year across 3,257 listed procedures. In addition to in-hospital treatment, beneficiaries receive post-operative financial assistance under Aarogya Aasara (up to ₹5,000 per month or ₹225 per day during recovery).
department: Dr. YSR Aarogyasri Health Care Trust, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefitDetails: Cashless in-patient healthcare coverage up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year, plus post-operative recovery allowance up to ₹5,00,000 total medical security.
eligibilitySummary: Resident of Andhra Pradesh holding a valid Rice Card or Aarogyasri Card, or families with annual income up to ₹5.0 Lakhs.

applicationSteps.title: Aarogya Mithra Assistance

applicationSteps.title: Cashless Treatment & Post-Operative Aid
applicationSteps.description: Avail cashless therapy and discharge; Aarogya Aasara recovery allowance disbursed via DBT.

name: Andhra Pradesh YSR Cheyutha Scheme
shortDescription: Direct financial aid of ₹75,000 over 4 years (₹18,750 per year) for SC, ST, BC, and Minority women aged 45-60 in AP.
fullDescription: YSR Cheyutha provides financial assistance of ₹75,000 in four equal tranches of ₹18,750 per year to women aged between 45 and 60 years belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Backward Class (BC), and Minority communities. In partnership with commercial leaders like Amul, ITC, and HUL, it equips women to set up sustainable retail, dairy, and grocery enterprises.
department: Department of Social Welfare & SERP, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefitDetails: ₹18,750 per year for 4 years (total ₹75,000) directly into the woman's bank account, plus technical and supply-chain linkages.
eligibilitySummary: Women resident in AP aged between 45 to 60 years belonging to SC, ST, BC, or Minority communities with valid Rice Card.

documents.name: AP Rice Card
documents.description: Valid Rice Card demonstrating BPL status.

applicationSteps.title: Identification by Village/Ward Volunteers
applicationSteps.description: Volunteer / Welfare Assistant conducts door-to-door verification of eligible age and caste.

applicationSteps.title: Social Audit at Gram/Ward Sachivalayam
applicationSteps.description: Eligible list displayed on notice boards and biometric eKYC collected.

applicationSteps.title: Annual Fund Crediting
applicationSteps.description: Annual installment of ₹18,750 credited directly into the woman's bank account.

name: Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
shortDescription: Direct benefit transfer of ₹2,000 every month to the woman head of household in Karnataka.
fullDescription: Gruha Lakshmi is Karnataka's landmark guarantee providing monthly direct benefit transfer of ₹2,000 (₹24,000 annually) into the bank accounts of women recognized as the head (Yajamani) of Antyodaya (AAY), BPL, or APL families. The scheme empowers women with continuous financial independence and helps meet household expenses.
department: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
benefitDetails: ₹2,000 per month directly transferred into the beneficiary woman's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
eligibilitySummary: Resident woman in Karnataka designated as the head of family on Antyodaya, BPL, or APL ration cards. Neither the woman nor her spouse can be an income-tax payer or GST-registered taxpayer.

documents.name: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Passbook

applicationSteps.title: Visit Karnataka One / Grama One Center
applicationSteps.description: Apply for free at any Karnataka One, Grama One, Bangalore One, or Bapuji Seva Kendra.

applicationSteps.title: Authentication & Verification
applicationSteps.description: Operator verifies ration card number and completes OTP/biometric Aadhaar authentication.

applicationSteps.title: Monthly DBT Credit
applicationSteps.description: Department releases ₹2,000 every month directly to the verified bank account.

name: Karnataka Shakti Scheme (Free Bus Travel for Women)
shortDescription: 100% free bus travel for all women and girl students domiciled in Karnataka across state RTC buses.
fullDescription: The Shakti Scheme grants free public bus travel to all women, girl students, and transgender persons resident in Karnataka. Applicable across all ordinary, express, and city bus services operated by the four state transport corporations (KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, and KKRTC) within Karnataka state limits.
department: Transport Department, Government of Karnataka
benefitDetails: Zero-fare tickets on all non-premium state buses across Karnataka without any journey count limitation.
eligibilitySummary: Women, girl students, and transgender persons domiciled in Karnataka presenting valid photo ID with Karnataka address or Shakti Smart Card.

documents.description: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Driving Licence, or Karnataka Smart Card.
documents.issuingAuthority: Govt of India / Govt of Karnataka

applicationSteps.description: Board any KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, or KKRTC non-luxury bus within Karnataka.

applicationSteps.title: Display Karnataka ID
applicationSteps.description: Show Aadhaar card or government photo ID verifying Karnataka domicile to the conductor.

applicationSteps.title: Obtain Free Shakti Ticket
applicationSteps.description: Conductor issues an electronic zero-value Shakti ticket.

name: Karnataka Gruha Jyothi Scheme (Up to 200 Units Free Electricity)
shortDescription: Up to 200 units of free monthly electricity for residential households in Karnataka.
fullDescription: Karnataka Gruha Jyothi ensures free domestic electricity for residential consumers whose monthly consumption falls within their calculated entitlement quota (calculated as average consumption of the previous 12 months + 10% buffer, subject to a maximum cap of 200 units). Tenants and homeowners alike are eligible.
department: Energy Department, Government of Karnataka (BESCOM, HESCOM, MESCOM, GESCOM, CESC)
benefitDetails: Zero electricity bill when monthly residential consumption is within the entitlement quota (up to 200 units).
eligibilitySummary: Domestic residential electricity consumers residing in Karnataka; meter account number linked with Aadhaar.

documents.name: Electricity Bill Account ID
documents.description: Account ID / Connection ID from the power utility bill.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Aadhaar of the occupant (owner or tenant).

applicationSteps.title: Register on Seva Sindhu Portal
applicationSteps.description: Visit sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in and select Gruha Jyothi.

applicationSteps.title: Enter ESCOM Connection ID & Aadhaar
applicationSteps.description: Authenticate via Aadhaar OTP and verify consumer account details.

applicationSteps.title: Receive Subsidized Zero Bill
applicationSteps.description: Eligible monthly consumption within entitlement yields a net zero electricity bill.

name: Karnataka Yuva Nidhi Scheme (Unemployment Financial Assistance)
shortDescription: Monthly financial aid of ₹3,000 for unemployed graduates and ₹1,500 for diploma holders in Karnataka for up to 2 years.
fullDescription: Karnataka Yuva Nidhi provides temporary financial relief to educated youth during job searches. It offers ₹3,000 per month for unemployed degree graduates and ₹1,500 per month for unemployed diploma holders who completed their degrees in Karnataka and remained without job or higher education enrollment for at least 180 days, paid for up to 24 months.
department: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood, Govt of Karnataka
benefitDetails: ₹3,000/month for degree graduates and ₹1,500/month for diploma holders for up to 24 months via DBT.
eligibilitySummary: Karnataka domicile candidates who graduated or passed diploma in academic years 2022-23 onwards, who remain unemployed or not enrolled in higher education for >= 180 days.

documents.name: Degree / Diploma Certificate & Marks Cards
documents.description: Graduation / Diploma passing certificate issued by recognized Karnataka university or board.

applicationSteps.title: Register on Seva Sindhu / Yuva Nidhi Portal
applicationSteps.description: Fill out the online application with registration number, university details, and Aadhaar.

applicationSteps.title: Submit Self-Declaration of Unemployment
applicationSteps.description: Attest that applicant is not employed in public or private sectors and not self-employed.

applicationSteps.title: Monthly DBT Crediting
applicationSteps.description: Stipend credited monthly; candidate submits periodic monthly self-attestation of continuing unemployment.

name: Karnataka Anna Bhagya Scheme (Food Security & Direct Benefit Transfer)
shortDescription: 10 kg food grains per person per month (5 kg grains + ₹170 cash DBT for additional 5 kg) for BPL families in Karnataka.
fullDescription: Karnataka Anna Bhagya guarantees 10 kg of food grains per person per month to Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH/BPL) ration card holders. It provides 5 kg food grains through the central NFSA allocation and credits ₹170 in cash DBT (calculated at ₹34 per kg for 5 kg) per member directly into the bank account of the head of the household.
department: Department of Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs, Govt of Karnataka
benefitDetails: 5 kg subsidized grains + ₹170 per person per month transferred directly to the household head's bank account via DBT.
eligibilitySummary: Resident of Karnataka enrolled under BPL (Priority Household) or Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) ration card with active Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

documents.name: BPL / Antyodaya Ration Card
documents.description: Active food card with member details.
documents.issuingAuthority: Food and Civil Supplies Dept, Karnataka

applicationSteps.title: Fair Price Shop Allocation
applicationSteps.description: Collect 5 kg free NFSA rice per person monthly from Fair Price Shop using biometric ePDS.

applicationSteps.title: Aadhaar Bank Account Seeding
applicationSteps.description: Ensure the head of family's bank account is mapped on NPCI Aadhaar payment bridge.

applicationSteps.title: Monthly Cash Transfer
applicationSteps.description: Food Department credits ₹170 per eligible member directly into the family head's bank account.

name: Maharashtra Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
shortDescription: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,500 (₹18,000 per year) directly transferred to eligible women aged 21-65 in Maharashtra.
fullDescription: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana is Maharashtra's flagship women empowerment welfare initiative. It transfers ₹1,500 per month (₹18,000 per year) directly into the Aadhaar-linked bank accounts of married, widowed, divorced, abandoned, or destitute women aged between 21 and 65 years whose annual family income is within ₹2.5 Lakhs.
department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
benefitDetails: ₹1,500 per month direct financial allowance credited via DBT (Aadhaar Payment Bridge).
eligibilitySummary: Resident woman in Maharashtra aged 21 to 65 years with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakhs (or holding Yellow/Orange ration card), not an income tax payer.

documents.name: Domicile Certificate or 15-Year Ration Card
documents.description: Maharashtra domicile certificate or yellow/orange ration card.

documents.name: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Account Passbook
documents.description: Single bank account in applicant's name with NPCI mapping.

applicationSteps.title: Register on Nari Shakti Doot App / Ladki Bahin Portal
applicationSteps.description: Download Nari Shakti Doot App or visit ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Documents and Complete eKYC
applicationSteps.description: Upload Aadhaar, ration card, bank passbook, and submit self-declaration.

applicationSteps.title: Approval & Monthly Disbursement
applicationSteps.description: Ward/Taluka committee verifies and initiates ₹1,500 monthly payment directly into bank account.

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
shortDescription: Universal cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 1,356 procedures in Maharashtra.
fullDescription: MJPJAY provides universal cashless hospitalization coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year to all citizens residing in Maharashtra. Integrated with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, it covers 1,356 identified secondary and tertiary medical and surgical treatments, renal transplants, oncology, cardiac interventions, and intensive care across recognized public and private hospitals.
department: State Health Assurance Society (SHAS), Public Health Department, Govt of Maharashtra
benefitDetails: Universal cashless healthcare coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for 1,356 surgeries, therapies, and diagnostics.
eligibilitySummary: All families domiciled in Maharashtra holding Yellow, Orange, or White Ration Cards or Maharashtra domicile certificate.

documents.name: Ration Card (Yellow / Orange / White)
documents.description: Valid Maharashtra ration card with family member names.
documents.issuingAuthority: Food and Civil Supplies Dept, Maharashtra

applicationSteps.title: Visit Network Hospital
applicationSteps.description: Approach any empaneled government or private network hospital in Maharashtra.

applicationSteps.title: Consult Arogya Mitra Desk
applicationSteps.description: Arogya Mitra verifies ration card and Aadhaar, generates e-card, and routes to specialist.

applicationSteps.title: Receive Cashless Treatment
applicationSteps.description: Hospital performs procedure cashless; discharge medications and diagnostics included.

name: Maharashtra MahaDBT Post-Matric Scholarship & Tuition Fee Waiver
shortDescription: 100% or 50% college tuition fee waiver and maintenance allowance for SC, ST, OBC, VJNT, and EBC students in Maharashtra.
fullDescription: MahaDBT Post-Matric Scholarships offer comprehensive financial support to students in Maharashtra studying in Class 11, 12, undergraduate, postgraduate, engineering, medical, and polytechnic courses. Covers 100% tuition and exam fee waiver for SC/ST and 50% to 100% for OBC, VJNT, SBC, and EBC/SEBC under Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna, plus monthly maintenance stipends.
department: Social Justice & Special Assistance / Higher & Technical Education Dept, Govt of Maharashtra
benefitDetails: Full or partial reimbursement of tuition and examination fees plus monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200 per month.
eligibilitySummary: Maharashtra domicile students enrolled in recognized post-matric courses through CAP/convenor quota. Income ceiling: up to ₹2.5 Lakhs (SC/ST) and ₹1.5 to ₹8.0 Lakhs depending on category/EBC scheme.

documents.name: Caste & Caste Validity Certificate
documents.description: Caste Certificate along with Scrutiny Committee Validity (for professional courses).

documents.name: Income Certificate from Tahsildar
documents.description: Valid income certificate for current financial year.

applicationSteps.title: Register on MahaDBT Portal
applicationSteps.description: Create applicant profile on mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in and complete Aadhaar biometric authentication.

applicationSteps.title: College Verification
applicationSteps.description: College verification clerk reviews uploaded certificates, bonafide, and attendance.

applicationSteps.title: Direct Scholarship Disbursal
applicationSteps.description: Tuition fee is directly reimbursed to the institute, and maintenance allowance is credited to the student's bank account.

name: Tamil Nadu Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (KMUT - Basic Income for Women)
shortDescription: Unconditional basic income support of ₹1,000 per month directly transferred to women heads of families in Tamil Nadu.
fullDescription: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (KMUT) provides ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000 annually) as universal basic income recognition to female heads of eligible households in Tamil Nadu. The payment is transferred directly into beneficiaries' Aadhaar-linked bank accounts via direct benefit transfer on the 15th of every month.
department: Special Programme Implementation & Revenue Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefitDetails: ₹1,000 per month deposited directly into the beneficiary woman's bank account via DBT.
eligibilitySummary: Woman head of family aged 21 years or older domiciled in Tamil Nadu; family annual income below ₹2.5 Lakhs; annual domestic electricity consumption below 3,600 units; family landholding below 5 acres wetland or 10 acres dryland.

documents.name: Tamil Nadu Smart Family Ration Card
documents.description: Smart Card showing applicant as head of the family.
documents.issuingAuthority: Civil Supplies & Consumer Protection Dept, TN

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Aadhaar linked to bank account and smart card.

documents.name: TANGEDCO Electricity Consumer Number
documents.description: Domestic electricity service number to verify annual consumption under 3,600 units.

applicationSteps.title: Application at Special Camp
applicationSteps.description: Submit application with smart card and electricity bill at Fair Price Shop / Ward special camps.

applicationSteps.title: Field Verification & eKYC
applicationSteps.description: Volunteers and Revenue authorities verify socio-economic criteria through biometric eKYC.

applicationSteps.title: Monthly Direct Credit
applicationSteps.description: ₹1,000 credited automatically into the beneficiary's bank account on the 15th of every month.

name: Tamil Nadu Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Higher Education Assurance)
shortDescription: Monthly financial grant of ₹1,000 for female students studying in colleges who completed Class 6-12 in Tamil Nadu Govt schools.
fullDescription: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn) encourages female education by granting ₹1,000 per month directly into bank accounts of girl students who studied in government schools from Class 6 to 12. It covers the entire duration of undergraduate degree, diploma, ITI, or professional college courses without disruption.
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefitDetails: ₹1,000 per month credited directly into the student's bank account throughout their college degree/diploma.
eligibilitySummary: Female students who studied continuously from Class 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu Government schools, enrolled in an undergraduate degree, diploma, or ITI course in Tamil Nadu.

documents.name: EMIS Student ID & School Bonafide
documents.description: EMIS number verifying Class 6 to 12 education in Tamil Nadu government schools.

documents.name: College Admission Bonafide
documents.description: Bonafide certificate confirming admission in recognized higher education institution.

documents.name: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Passbook
documents.description: Student's single bank account with NPCI mapping.

applicationSteps.title: College Level Registration
applicationSteps.description: College nodal officer uploads student EMIS number and certificates on pudhumaipenn.tn.gov.in.

applicationSteps.title: Automated EMIS Verification
applicationSteps.description: School Education Department automatically cross-checks government school schooling records.

applicationSteps.title: Monthly DBT Disbursement
applicationSteps.description: State treasury deposits ₹1,000 every month directly into the student's bank account.

name: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
shortDescription: Cashless hospitalization health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in empaneled hospitals in Tamil Nadu.
fullDescription: CMCHIS provides cashless secondary and tertiary medical treatments up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for low-income families in Tamil Nadu. Covering 1,513 medical and surgical procedures, 52 specialized diagnostic tests, and 8 high-end surgeries in recognized government and private hospitals.
department: Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project (TNHSP), Health and Family Welfare Dept, Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefitDetails: Cashless in-patient care up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 1,513 surgical procedures and therapies.
eligibilitySummary: Resident families in Tamil Nadu having annual family income below ₹1,20,000 as certified by VAO/Revenue authorities, or enrolled on smart family ration card.

documents.name: Tamil Nadu Smart Ration Card
documents.description: Family card showing all family members.

documents.name: Income Certificate from VAO / Tahsildar
documents.description: Income certificate certifying annual family income below ₹1.2 Lakhs.

applicationSteps.title: Obtain CMCHIS Smart Health Card
applicationSteps.description: Enroll at the District Collectorate CMCHIS kiosk with smart ration card and income certificate.

applicationSteps.title: Visit Empaneled Network Hospital
applicationSteps.description: Report to CMCHIS liaison desk at any empaneled government or private hospital.

applicationSteps.title: Avail Cashless Hospitalization
applicationSteps.description: Pre-authorization approved electronically; treatment, diagnostics, and food delivered cashless.

name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
shortDescription: Phased conditional financial grant totaling ₹25,000 for girl children across 6 key developmental milestones in UP.
fullDescription: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana delivers ₹25,000 conditional cash transfers disbursed across 6 developmental milestones: Stage 1 (Birth: ₹3,000), Stage 2 (Complete 1-year immunization: ₹2,000), Stage 3 (Admission to Class 1: ₹3,000), Stage 4 (Admission to Class 6: ₹3,000), Stage 5 (Admission to Class 9: ₹5,000), and Stage 6 (Admission to undergraduate degree or diploma of >= 2 years: ₹7,000).
department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
benefitDetails: ₹25,000 cumulative financial assistance released in 6 milestone-based installments directly to the girl's/mother's bank account.
eligibilitySummary: Resident of Uttar Pradesh with annual family income up to ₹3,00,000; maximum of two daughters per family (or up to three in case of second birth twins).

documents.name: Birth Certificate of Girl Child
documents.description: Birth certificate issued by Nagar Nigam / Gram Panchayat.

documents.name: Joint / Single Bank Passbook
documents.description: Bank account in girl's or mother's name with IFSC and Aadhaar seeding.

applicationSteps.title: Register on MKSY Portal
applicationSteps.description: Citizen registers on mksy.up.gov.in and enters family details and Aadhaar.

applicationSteps.title: Apply for Specific Category / Stage
applicationSteps.description: Select stage (e.g. Birth, Class 1, Class 6, Class 9, College) and upload admission / immunization proof.

applicationSteps.title: Verification & DBT Release
applicationSteps.description: Block Development Officer (BDO) or SDM approves application, and installment is credited via PFMS.

name: Uttar Pradesh Post-Matric Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement Scheme
shortDescription: Full fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance stipend for college students from SC, ST, General, OBC, and Minority communities in UP.
fullDescription: The Uttar Pradesh Post-Matric Scholarship and Fee Reimbursement Scheme reimburses tuition fees and grants monthly maintenance allowances to students studying in Class 11, 12, undergraduate, postgraduate, engineering, medical, and polytechnic courses in recognized institutions. Covers non-refundable fee components up to ₹50,000+ plus maintenance allowances.
department: Social Welfare, Backward Classes Welfare & Minority Welfare Departments, Govt of Uttar Pradesh
benefitDetails: Direct reimbursement of non-refundable course fees plus monthly maintenance stipend (up to ₹1,200/month for hostellers and ₹600/month for day scholars).
eligibilitySummary: Permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh enrolled in recognized post-matric course; annual family income <= ₹2.5 Lakhs (SC/ST/General) and <= ₹2.0 Lakhs (OBC/Minority).

documents.name: Income Certificate from eDistrict UP
documents.description: Valid income certificate for current financial year.

documents.name: Fee Receipt and Allotment Letter
documents.description: Current year college fee deposit receipt and entrance admission slip.

applicationSteps.title: Online Registration on UP Scholarship Portal
applicationSteps.description: Submit application on scholarship.up.gov.in, link DigiLocker, and authenticate Aadhaar.

applicationSteps.title: Institute Verification and Forwarding
applicationSteps.description: College verifies fee receipt, attendance, and forwards application to District Welfare Officer.

applicationSteps.title: District Scrutiny & PFMS Disbursement
applicationSteps.description: District scholarship committee approves grant; funds disbursed via PFMS into student's bank account.

name: West Bengal Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme (Basic Income Support)
shortDescription: Monthly basic income support of ₹1,200 for SC/ST and ₹1,000 for General/OBC women aged 25-60 in West Bengal.
fullDescription: Lakshmir Bhandar provides monthly unconditional financial assistance to adult female members of households in West Bengal. Female heads aged 25 to 60 years receive ₹1,200 per month for SC/ST households and ₹1,000 per month for General and OBC households directly into their bank accounts.
department: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, Govt of West Bengal
benefitDetails: ₹1,200/month for SC/ST women and ₹1,000/month for General/OBC women transferred directly via DBT.
eligibilitySummary: Female resident of West Bengal aged 25 to 60 years enrolled under Swasthya Sathi or Khadya Sathi, not employed in government jobs or receiving regular government pensions.

documents.name: Swasthya Sathi Card
documents.description: Health card showing applicant as a beneficiary.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Aadhaar card with West Bengal address.

documents.name: SC/ST Certificate
documents.description: Sub-divisional officer certificate for higher ₹1,200 rate.

applicationSteps.title: Application at Duare Sarkar Camp
applicationSteps.description: Collect and submit application form during Duare Sarkar outreach camps or municipal offices.

applicationSteps.title: BDO / SDO Verification
applicationSteps.description: Block Development Officer verifies Aadhaar and Swasthya Sathi card mapping.

applicationSteps.title: Monthly Direct Benefit Transfer
applicationSteps.description: State treasury deposits ₹1,000 or ₹1,200 monthly directly into the woman's single bank account.

name: West Bengal Kanyashree Prakalpa Scheme (K1 & K2)
shortDescription: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000 (K1) and one-time grant of ₹25,000 (K2) for adolescent girls in West Bengal.
fullDescription: Kanyashree Prakalpa is an internationally recognized conditional cash transfer initiative combating child marriage and incentivizing girl child education. Tier 1 (K1) gives an annual scholarship of ₹1,000 to unmarried girls aged 13-18 enrolled in Class 8 to 12. Tier 2 (K2) awards a one-time grant of ₹25,000 when an unmarried girl reaches 18 years and is enrolled in college or vocational studies.
department: Department of Women and Child Development and Social Welfare, Govt of West Bengal
benefitDetails: K1: ₹1,000 annual scholarship; K2: ₹25,000 one-time grant deposited directly into the girl's bank account.
eligibilitySummary: Unmarried girl resident in West Bengal enrolled as regular student in recognized school, college, or polytechnic institution.

documents.name: School / College Bonafide Certificate
documents.description: Certificate showing regular enrollment and date of birth.

documents.name: Unmarried Self-Declaration
documents.description: Declaration endorsed by parents/guardians that the girl is unmarried.

documents.name: Applicant Single Bank Account Passbook
documents.description: Savings bank account in the girl's own name.

applicationSteps.title: Application Form at School / College
applicationSteps.description: Obtain and submit the K1 or K2 application form through your educational institution.

applicationSteps.title: Institution Portal Upload
applicationSteps.description: Head of school/college enters student details and uploads documents on wbkanyashree.gov.in.

applicationSteps.title: Administrative Sanction & Fund Disbursal
applicationSteps.description: District Magistrate sanction leads to direct bank crediting of ₹1,000 (K1) or ₹25,000 (K2).

name: West Bengal Swasthya Sathi Universal Health Scheme
shortDescription: Universal cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in West Bengal.
fullDescription: Swasthya Sathi is West Bengal's universal group health assurance scheme providing up to ₹5,00,000 cashless hospitalization coverage per family per year across secondary and tertiary healthcare procedures. Smart biometric cards are issued in the name of the eldest female member (mother/grandmother/wife) of the household, ensuring complete family coverage.
department: Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal
benefitDetails: Cashless in-patient hospitalization up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 2,000+ medical and surgical packages in empaneled hospitals.
eligibilitySummary: Universal coverage for all resident families in West Bengal not covered under another statutory government medical scheme.

documents.name: Swasthya Sathi Smart Card
documents.description: Biometric smart card issued in the name of female family head.
documents.issuingAuthority: Health & Family Welfare Dept, West Bengal

applicationSteps.title: Enroll at Duare Sarkar Camp
applicationSteps.description: Submit Form-B with family details and photo of female head at Duare Sarkar camp.

applicationSteps.title: Receive Biometric Smart Card
applicationSteps.description: Collect personalized Swasthya Sathi smart card with encoded family biometric data.

applicationSteps.title: Avail Cashless Hospitalization
applicationSteps.description: Present smart card at Swasthya Sathi helpdesk in any empaneled hospital for cashless treatment.

name: Delhi Mukhyamantri Mahila Samman Yojana
shortDescription: Direct financial assistance of ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000 per year) for non-taxpayer adult women in Delhi.
fullDescription: Mukhyamantri Mahila Samman Yojana provides a monthly financial support of ₹1,000 (₹12,000 per year) directly to adult women residing in the National Capital Territory of Delhi. The scheme aims to enhance financial security and autonomy for women who are not government employees, regular taxpayers, or recipients of other governmental welfare pensions.
department: Department of Women and Child Development, Govt of NCT of Delhi
benefitDetails: ₹1,000 per month transferred directly to the beneficiary woman's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
eligibilitySummary: Women aged 18 years and above who are registered voters in NCT of Delhi with valid Delhi voter ID, not paying income tax, not central/state government employees, and not drawing other government pensions.

Mahila Samman Yojana Policy Resolution Section 3.1
Mahila Samman Yojana Policy Resolution Section 3.2

documents.name: Delhi Voter Identity Card (EPIC)
documents.description: Valid Voter ID card showing registration in Delhi assembly constituency.
documents.issuingAuthority: Election Commission of India / CEO Delhi

documents.name: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Passbook
documents.description: Beneficiary's single bank account with NPCI mapping.

applicationSteps.title: Online / Kiosk Registration
applicationSteps.description: Submit application on the official Delhi Government portal or at authorized registration centers.

applicationSteps.title: Self-Declaration of Non-Taxpayer Status
applicationSteps.description: Sign self-declaration confirming non-taxpayer status and that applicant is not receiving any other government pension.

applicationSteps.title: Monthly Direct Benefit Transfer
applicationSteps.description: WCD department transfers ₹1,000 every month directly to the verified Aadhaar-linked bank account.

name: Delhi Free Power & Water Lifeline Scheme
shortDescription: 100% free electricity up to 200 units/month and up to 20,000 liters of free potable water/month in NCT of Delhi.
fullDescription: The Delhi Lifeline Scheme provides 100% electricity subsidy for domestic consumption up to 200 units per month (and 50% subsidy up to ₹800 for consumption between 201 and 400 units) for consumers opting in. Concurrently, it provides up to 20,000 litres of clean potable water per household per month completely free of charge (with zero sewer and service charges) for all residential metered connections under Delhi Jal Board.
department: Power Department & Delhi Jal Board, Government of NCT of Delhi
benefitDetails: Zero electricity bill for up to 200 units/month + zero water bill for consumption up to 20,000 litres/month for domestic consumers.
eligibilitySummary: Domestic residential electricity consumers in NCT of Delhi (BRPL, BYPL, TPDDL) opting into the power subsidy, and households with functional domestic water meters under Delhi Jal Board.

documents.name: Electricity Bill CA Number
documents.description: Consumer Account number on BSES Yamuna, BSES Rajdhani, or Tata Power DDL bill.

documents.name: Delhi Jal Board (DJB) K No
documents.description: Water connection K Number showing metered domestic connection.

applicationSteps.title: Opt-In for Electricity Subsidy
applicationSteps.description: Submit opt-in request by sending WhatsApp message with CA number to 7011311111 or via DISCOM website.

applicationSteps.title: Ensure Functional Water Meter
applicationSteps.description: Ensure working functional water meter installed and registered with Delhi Jal Board.

applicationSteps.title: Receive Zero Monthly Utility Bills
applicationSteps.description: DISCOM and DJB automatically issue zero bills for consumption within eligible lifeline caps.

name: Telangana Yuva Vikasam (Vidya Bharosa Card)
shortDescription: Financial assistance card up to ₹5 Lakhs for students to cover college admission fees, coaching, and international exams.
fullDescription: Yuva Vikasam is part of Telangana Government's Six Guarantees providing Vidya Bharosa financial assistance cards of up to ₹5,00,000 for students to pursue higher education, specialized skill development, and competitive examination coaching.
department: Higher Education Department, Government of Telangana
feeDetails: Official application is free of cost. Beware of middlemen charging illegal fees.
benefitDetails: Financial guarantee card covering up to ₹5,00,000 for college admission, coaching fees, and professional certification courses.
eligibilitySummary: Resident of Telangana, enrolled in accredited intermediate, undergraduate, or postgraduate college with family annual income <= ₹2 Lakhs.
scamWarning: Official government applications must be submitted via the designated portal or authorised MeeSeva/CSC centre. No third-party agent is authorized to collect fees or guarantee approval.

applicationSteps.title: Apply on Praja Palana / MeeSeva Portal
applicationSteps.description: Submit application with college enrollment details.

applicationSteps.title: Institutional Endorsement
applicationSteps.description: College Principal verifies student bonafide details on portal.

applicationSteps.title: Vidya Bharosa Card Issuance
applicationSteps.description: Digital card issued with credit line for verified educational expenses.

name: Telangana Cheyutha Social Security Pension Scheme
shortDescription: Monthly social security pension of ₹4,000 per month for senior citizens, widows, single women, beedi workers, and weavers in Telangana.
fullDescription: Under the Cheyutha Guarantee, the Government of Telangana provides enhanced social security pensions of ₹4,000 per month (and ₹6,000/month for persons with severe disabilities) to ensure vulnerable and elderly citizens live with security and self-respect.
department: Panchayat Raj & Rural Development Department, Government of Telangana
feeDetails: Official application is free of cost. Beware of middlemen charging illegal fees.
benefitDetails: ₹4,000 per month direct bank transfer for elderly, widows, toddy tappers, weavers, and beedi workers; ₹6,000 per month for differently abled persons.
eligibilitySummary: Telangana resident, age 57+ for elderly pension; or verified widow / beedi worker / disabled person holding white ration card.
scamWarning: Official government applications must be submitted via the designated portal or authorised MeeSeva/CSC centre. No third-party agent is authorized to collect fees or guarantee approval.

documents.name: Telangana Food Security Card (White Ration Card)

applicationSteps.title: Submit Application via Praja Palana / MeeSeva
applicationSteps.description: Fill Cheyutha application at nearest MeeSeva or Gram Panchayat office.

applicationSteps.title: Field Verification by MPDO / Municipal Commissioner
applicationSteps.description: Verification of BPL status and biometric authentication.

applicationSteps.title: Monthly DBT Credit
applicationSteps.description: Pension deposited on 1st of every month directly into postal/bank account.

name: Telangana T-PRIDE (Program for Rapid Incubation of Dalit Entrepreneurs)
shortDescription: Up to 45% investment subsidy (max ₹75 Lakhs) and 5% interest subvention for SC and ST entrepreneurs setting up industrial units or commercial transport.
fullDescription: T-PRIDE is a targeted affirmative initiative by Government of Telangana providing preferential capital subsidies, stamp duty reimbursements, subsidized power, and 45% capital investment subsidy for Dalit and Adivasi entrepreneurs.
department: Industries and Commerce Department, Government of Telangana

name: Rajasthan Indira Gandhi Smartphone Yojana (Free Smartphone & 3-Year Internet)
shortDescription: Free Android 4G/5G smartphone + ₹6,800 DBT wallet for 3 years of free voice calling and 20 GB monthly data for women family heads in Rajasthan.
fullDescription: IGSY provides free 4G/5G smartphones with preloaded government welfare apps and 3 years of free high-speed internet to women heads of families enrolled under Chiranjeevi / Jan Aadhaar and girl students studying in higher education.
department: Department of Information Technology and Communication (DoIT&C), Govt of Rajasthan
feeDetails: Official application is free of cost. Beware of middlemen charging illegal fees.
benefitDetails: Free 4G/5G smartphone device (₹6,125 voucher) + ₹675 direct wallet credit for 9 months initial internet + ₹900/year for next 2 years.
eligibilitySummary: Women head of family holding Jan Aadhaar who worked 100 days in MGNREGA / 50 days in Indira Gandhi Urban Employment, or girl students in Class 9-12/College.
scamWarning: Official government applications must be submitted via the designated portal or authorised MeeSeva/CSC centre. No third-party agent is authorized to collect fees or guarantee approval.

applicationSteps.title: Receive SMS Invitation for Camp
applicationSteps.description: Eligible women receive SMS alert with camp token date and location.

applicationSteps.title: Camp e-KYC & Mobile Selection
applicationSteps.description: Visit district camp, choose telecom operator (Airtel, Jio, BSNL) and handset brand.

applicationSteps.title: Receive Configured Smartphone
applicationSteps.description: Wallet credit transferred instantly to purchase phone and activate SIM card.

name: Madhya Pradesh Mukhyamantri Jan Kalyan (Sambal 2.0) Yojana
shortDescription: Integrated social security card offering ₹4 Lakh accidental death cover, ₹2 Lakh natural death cover, ₹16,000 maternity assistance, and free electricity.
fullDescription: Sambal 2.0 is an umbrella social security system for millions of unorganised workers in Madhya Pradesh, delivering cradle-to-grave financial protection: antenatal assistance, institutional maternity cash, scholarships for children, accidental insurance, and funeral aid.
department: Labour Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
feeDetails: Official application is free of cost. Beware of middlemen charging illegal fees.
benefitDetails: ₹4,00,000 accidental death relief; ₹2,00,000 natural death relief; ₹16,000 maternity aid; ₹5,000 funeral grant; 100% free higher education fees for children.
eligibilitySummary: Unorganised workers resident in MP aged 18 to 60 years whose family does not own more than 1 hectare of land and does not pay income tax.
scamWarning: Official government applications must be submitted via the designated portal or authorised MeeSeva/CSC centre. No third-party agent is authorized to collect fees or guarantee approval.

applicationSteps.title: Apply Online on Sambal Portal
applicationSteps.description: Register using 9-digit Samagra Member ID.

applicationSteps.title: Inquiry by Gram Panchayat / Ward Officer
applicationSteps.description: Secretary verifies unorganised worker status within 15 days.

applicationSteps.title: Download Sambal Digital Card
applicationSteps.description: Receive QR-coded Sambal Card unlocking all 12 converged state welfare schemes.

name: Bihar Mukhyamantri Gram Parivahan Yojana (Rural Commercial Vehicle Subsidy)
shortDescription: 50% capital subsidy up to ₹1,00,000 for purchasing 4 to 10-seater commercial passenger vehicles (auto, e-rickshaw, magic) in rural Bihar.
fullDescription: Administered by the Transport Department in Bihar, this scheme provides 50% capital grant up to ₹1 Lakh to rural youth belonging to SC, ST, and EBC categories to buy commercial passenger vehicles, linking remote panchayats with block and district headquarters.
department: Transport Department, Government of Bihar
feeDetails: Official application is free of cost. Beware of middlemen charging illegal fees.
benefitDetails: 50% subsidy of purchase price (up to ₹1,00,000) for buying new 4 to 10-seater commercial vehicles (Tata Magic, Mahindra Bolero Camper, Auto-rickshaws, or E-Rickshaws).
eligibilitySummary: Permanent resident of rural Panchayat in Bihar, minimum age 21 years, belonging to SC, ST, or EBC, possessing a valid commercial driving licence.
scamWarning: Official government applications must be submitted via the designated portal or authorised MeeSeva/CSC centre. No third-party agent is authorized to collect fees or guarantee approval.

applicationSteps.description: Fill application selecting Panchayat and preferred vehicle model.

applicationSteps.title: Block & Sub-Divisional Selection Committee
applicationSteps.description: SDO and BDO select 5 beneficiaries per Panchayat (3 SC/ST and 2 EBC).

applicationSteps.title: Vehicle Purchase & 50% Subsidy Credit
applicationSteps.description: Purchase vehicle from authorized dealer; ₹1 Lakh subsidy credited to loan account.

name: Odisha Madhu Babu Pension Yojana (MBPY - Universal Social Pension)
shortDescription: Monthly social security pension of ₹500 to ₹900 per month for elderly, widows, persons with disabilities, and transgender persons in Odisha.
fullDescription: MBPY provides monthly direct pensions to destitute elderly citizens, widows, individuals with disabilities, and destitute transgender persons across Odisha, delivered on the 15th of each month under the 'Jana Seva Diwas' through cash-at-doorstep or DBT.
department: Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (SSEPD) Dept, Govt of Odisha
feeDetails: Official application is free of cost. Beware of middlemen charging illegal fees.
benefitDetails: ₹500 per month (for age up to 79) and ₹700 to ₹900 per month (for age 80+ and severe disability) delivered transparently every month.
eligibilitySummary: Resident of Odisha aged 60+ (or widow/disabled of any age), family annual income <= ₹24,000, not receiving any other central/state pension.
scamWarning: Official government applications must be submitted via the designated portal or authorised MeeSeva/CSC centre. No third-party agent is authorized to collect fees or guarantee approval.

applicationSteps.title: Apply at Block Development Office or Mo Seva Kendra
applicationSteps.description: Submit MBPY application form.

applicationSteps.title: Gram Panchayat Enquiry
applicationSteps.description: Social security officer verifies residency and non-pensioner status.

applicationSteps.title: Monthly Pension Distribution
applicationSteps.description: Receive monthly cash directly in Gram Panchayat on 15th or through DBT.

name: Gujarat Namo Saraswati Yojana (Class 11-12 Science Stream Incentive)
shortDescription: Scholarship of ₹25,000 over two years (₹10,000 in Class 11 and ₹15,000 in Class 12) to encourage girl students to pursue Science stream.
fullDescription: Namo Saraswati Yojana incentivizes girl students across Gujarat to opt for Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) streams in secondary school, paying ₹25,000 across Classes 11 and 12 to build female representation in engineering and medicine.
department: Education Department, Government of Gujarat
feeDetails: Official application is free of cost. Beware of middlemen charging illegal fees.
benefitDetails: ₹25,000 direct bank transfer: ₹10,000 in Class 11 (₹1,000/month for 10 months) and ₹15,000 in Class 12 (₹1,500/month for 10 months).
eligibilitySummary: Girl students studying in Class 11 or 12 in Science stream in any government, grant-in-aid, or recognized private school in Gujarat, family income <= ₹6 Lakhs.
scamWarning: Official government applications must be submitted via the designated portal or authorised MeeSeva/CSC centre. No third-party agent is authorized to collect fees or guarantee approval.

applicationSteps.description: DEO verifies science stream registration.

applicationSteps.title: Monthly DBT Transfer
applicationSteps.description: Stipend credited monthly directly to student's bank account.

name: West Bengal Rupashree Prakalpa (One-Time Marriage Grant)
shortDescription: One-time cash grant of ₹25,000 transferred to adult girls from economically stressed families before their marriage in West Bengal.
fullDescription: Rupashree Prakalpa provides one-time financial assistance of ₹25,000 to adult girls aged 18+ whose family annual income <= ₹1.5 Lakhs, ensuring poor families do not have to borrow at exorbitant interest rates for marriage arrangements.
department: Department of Women and Child Development and Social Welfare, Govt of West Bengal
feeDetails: Official application is free of cost. Beware of middlemen charging illegal fees.
benefitDetails: One-time grant of ₹25,000 credited directly via DBT to the bride's personal bank account before the solemnization of marriage.
eligibilitySummary: Unmarried girl aged 18+ resident of West Bengal for at least 5 years, marrying for the first time, family annual income <= ₹1.5 Lakhs.
scamWarning: Official government applications must be submitted via the designated portal or authorised MeeSeva/CSC centre. No third-party agent is authorized to collect fees or guarantee approval.

applicationSteps.description: Officer visits residence to verify age of bride and groom and wedding date.

applicationSteps.title: Direct Bank Credit before Marriage
applicationSteps.description: ₹25,000 transferred directly to bride's bank account before wedding day.

name: Andhra Pradesh YSR Nethanna Nestham (Handloom Weavers Livelihood)
shortDescription: Annual financial assistance of ₹24,000 per year directly to every handloom weaver family owning a loom to upgrade equipment and purchase yarn.
fullDescription: Under YSR Nethanna Nestham, the Government of Andhra Pradesh provides ₹24,000 every year directly to every weaver family possessing a handloom to modernize loom infrastructure, purchase raw material yarn, and compete with powerlooms.
department: Department of Handlooms and Textiles, Government of Andhra Pradesh
feeDetails: Official application is free of cost. Beware of middlemen charging illegal fees.
benefitDetails: ₹24,000 per year direct financial grant credited in one lump sum into the handloom weaver's bank account via DBT.
eligibilitySummary: Handloom weaver family owning and operating a handloom in Andhra Pradesh, holding BPL Rice Card.
scamWarning: Official government applications must be submitted via the designated portal or authorised MeeSeva/CSC centre. No third-party agent is authorized to collect fees or guarantee approval.

applicationSteps.title: Annual DBT Credit
applicationSteps.description: ₹24,000 credited directly into the weaver's account.

name: Telangana Nethannaku Cheyutha (Weavers Thrift Fund & Social Security)
shortDescription: Government matching contribution of 16% (double the weaver's 8% monthly contribution) in a specialized 3-year lock-in welfare thrift fund.
fullDescription: Nethannaku Cheyutha is Telangana's dedicated thrift fund scheme for handloom and powerloom weavers. When a weaver deposits 8% of their monthly wage, the Telangana Government contributes double (16% for handloom, 8% for powerloom) into their thrift account, accumulating a substantial financial corpus with loan facilities during crisis.
department: Department of Handlooms and Textiles, Government of Telangana
feeDetails: Official application is free of cost. Beware of middlemen charging illegal fees.
benefitDetails: Government contributes 16% matching grant on handloom weaver earnings (8% on powerloom) credited monthly to the weaver's thrift bank account, with loan withdrawal facility up to 50% after 3 years.
eligibilitySummary: Active handloom and powerloom weavers, ancillary workers (dyeing, warping, winding) aged 18+ residing in Telangana.
scamWarning: Official government applications must be submitted via the designated portal or authorised MeeSeva/CSC centre. No third-party agent is authorized to collect fees or guarantee approval.

applicationSteps.description: Open designated thrift deposit account in cooperative bank or commercial bank.

applicationSteps.title: Monthly 8% Wage Deposit
applicationSteps.description: Weaver deposits 8% of earned wages through cooperative society or master weaver.

applicationSteps.title: Government 16% Matching Credit
applicationSteps.description: Handlooms department verifies wage records and credits double matching contribution directly.

name: Telangana Dalit Bandhu Scheme (₹10 Lakh 100% Capital Grant)
shortDescription: 100% non-repayable direct capital grant of ₹10 Lakhs per Dalit family without bank loan or mortgage to establish self-chosen businesses.
fullDescription: Dalit Bandhu is a revolutionary affirmative economic empowerment scheme by the Government of Telangana providing ₹10,00,000 as a direct 100% grant to every eligible Dalit family to start independent commercial enterprises (dairy, transport, retail, construction, manufacturing) with complete freedom of choice.
department: Scheduled Castes Development Department, Government of Telangana
feeDetails: Official application is free of cost. Beware of middlemen charging illegal fees.
benefitDetails: ₹10,00,000 direct 100% non-repayable grant deposited into a special Dalit Bandhu savings account, with no bank loan linkage or collateral requirement.
eligibilitySummary: Scheduled Caste (SC) families domiciled in Telangana verified through electronic Food Security Card and Integrated Community Certificate.
scamWarning: Official government applications must be submitted via the designated portal or authorised MeeSeva/CSC centre. No third-party agent is authorized to collect fees or guarantee approval.

applicationSteps.title: Direct ₹10 Lakh Account Credit
applicationSteps.description: ₹10,00,000 transferred to beneficiary's special Dalit Bandhu bank account for asset acquisition.

name: Andhra Pradesh Jagananna Thodu (Interest-Free Loans for Street Vendors)
shortDescription: Collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000 to ₹20,000 with 100% interest reimbursed by the Andhra Pradesh Government for street vendors.
fullDescription: Jagananna Thodu frees roadside street vendors, cart pullers, and traditional artisans from ruthless private money lenders by providing ₹10,000 to ₹20,000 bank working capital loans where the AP Government pays 100% of the interest directly to the bank upon prompt repayment.

feeDetails: Official application is free of cost. Beware of middlemen charging illegal fees.
benefitDetails: ₹10,000 initial bank loan (enhanced to ₹20,000 on repayment) with 100% interest subvention credited directly into the vendor's bank account every 6 months.
eligibilitySummary: Street vendors, footpath traders, pushcart operators, and traditional artisans aged 18+ in AP holding BPL Rice Card.
scamWarning: Official government applications must be submitted via the designated portal or authorised MeeSeva/CSC centre. No third-party agent is authorized to collect fees or guarantee approval.

name: Karnataka Anna Bhagya Scheme (10 kg Free Foodgrains / Direct DBT Cash)
shortDescription: 10 kg free foodgrains per person per month (5 kg central grain + cash DBT of ₹170/person per month in lieu of additional 5 kg grain) for BPL families in Karnataka.
fullDescription: Anna Bhagya guarantees absolute hunger-free living across Karnataka by providing 10 kg free rice per person per month to all BPL and Antyodaya households, transferring ₹34 per kg (₹170 per person per month) directly via DBT into the bank accounts of women heads of households.
department: Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Karnataka
feeDetails: Official application is free of cost. Beware of middlemen charging illegal fees.
benefitDetails: 5 kg free rice distributed physically at Fair Price Shops + ₹170 direct DBT cash transfer per family member per month credited directly to the woman head's bank account.
eligibilitySummary: All Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH / BPL) ration card holders residing in Karnataka.
scamWarning: Official government applications must be submitted via the designated portal or authorised MeeSeva/CSC centre. No third-party agent is authorized to collect fees or guarantee approval.

applicationSteps.title: Monthly DBT Cash Credit
applicationSteps.description: ₹170 per person transferred directly into family head's bank account on 10th of every month.

name: Tamil Nadu Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam (Doorstep Healthcare Scheme)

scamWarning: Official government applications must be submitted via the designated portal or authorised MeeSeva/CSC centre. No third-party agent is authorized to collect fees or guarantee approval.

scamWarning: Official government applications must be submitted via the designated portal or authorised MeeSeva/CSC centre. No third-party agent is authorized to collect fees or guarantee approval.
